**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We believe this is the scale of change within reach—and we’re working to make sure everyone shares in it.

2. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. That future belongs to all of us.

3. Within the next 20 years, superintelligent AI can transform what’s possible for humanity. We believe that if it is built, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today.

**(b) Newsletter opening (105 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. This is not a distant promise of incremental progress. It is a future in which extraordinary intelligence expands what people can create, discover, and achieve—and the benefits reach everyone. The choices we make now will shape how this transformation unfolds and who gets to share in its gains. We are here to meet this moment with ambition and purpose: to build a world where superintelligent AI’s immense potential translates into greater prosperity for every person, everywhere.
